# awscc_drs_source_network (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::DRS::SourceNetwork



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The ARN of the Source Network.
- `origin_account_id` (String) The account ID containing the VPC to protect.
- `origin_region` (String) The region containing the VPC to protect.
- `source_network_id` (String) The ID of the Source Network.
- `tags` (Attributes List) A set of tags associated with the Source Network. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `vpc_id` (String) The VPC ID to protect.
